issues.title: OpenCode V2 compatibility: SKILL.md frontmatter and runtime assumptions
OpenCode detection & skill install path point to ~/.opencode, but OpenCode uses ~/.config/opencode
OpenCode v2 integration: fix skills install path + add mcp target

en.headline: 33 commits across two repos, 3 issues on OpenCode v2 compatibility
en.summary: sogeisetsu pushed 32 own commits to `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` plus 1 own commit to `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, with 11 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` on the latter. In `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`, the work centered on v0.3.0 documentation sync (landing page, `AGENTS`, `FILE_TREE`, `CHANGELOG`, `PLAN`, README pair) and install guidance clarifying the two one-liners are alternatives, plus a `feat(gate)` change that weaves counter-evidence instead of labelling it, a `feat(read_table)` salvage of `docx_to_md`, and a `chore` marking `test/` as retired in `.gitignore`. The `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` commit fixed the daily report so a `0` commit badge is no longer coerced to `1`, unified badge layout, and forced inline code in AI summaries. On issues, sogeisetsu opened `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` #180 on OpenCode V2 compatibility for `SKILL.md` frontmatter and runtime assumptions, opened `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #458 on OpenCode v2 integration (skills install path plus `mcp` target), and commented on `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #254 about the mismatch between `~/.opencode` and `~/.config/opencode`. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded for the day.

zh.headline: 两个仓库共 33 次提交，围绕 OpenCode v2 兼容性提出 3 个 issue
zh.summary: sogeisetsu 在 `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 提交了 32 次本人提交，在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 提交了 1 次本人提交，后者另有 11 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 的工作主要围绕 v0.3.0 的文档同步（落地页、`AGENTS`、`FILE_TREE`、`CHANGELOG`、`PLAN`、README 对）以及安装说明澄清两条 one-liner 互为替代，同时包含 `feat(gate)` 将反证编织进流程而非仅打标签、`feat(read_table)` 抢救 `docx_to_md`，以及 `chore` 在 `.gitignore` 中标记 `test/` 退役。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的提交修复了日报中提交数角标为 `0` 时被兜底成 `1` 的问题，统一了徽章排版，并强制 AI 摘要使用内联代码。Issue 方面，sogeisetsu 新开了 `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` #180，讨论 OpenCode V2 下 `SKILL.md` frontmatter 与运行时假设的兼容性；新开了 `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #458，涉及 OpenCode v2 集成中的 skills 安装路径与 `mcp` target；并在 `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #254 上留言，指出 `~/.opencode` 与 `~/.config/opencode` 的路径不一致。当日无 PR、无 review、无 release。
